subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Sam,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Per our demo, I wanted to capture the performance SLOs we discussed and propose concrete next steps so we can validate feasibility on our side.

Quick recap of requested SLO targets (please confirm / correct):
- p95 latency target: <= 300ms for typical customer-facing prompts (~512 tokens, model: LlamaX-13B quantized)
- sustained throughput: ~200 requests/sec (peak 350 rps bursts)
- concurrency: 50 steady concurrent sessions, spikes to 200 concurrent streams during market open
- streaming: SSE (client receives token-streaming) with max chunk latency <= 100ms per SSE chunk
- tail latency: p99 target <= 750ms

Attachments: redwood-slo-checklist.pdf (proposed test matrix) and 20280327-fintechco-demo-results.csv (sample trace from the demo).

Proposed next steps (MAP):
1) You confirm targets above and share 2–3 representative sample payloads (prompt + average token sizes).
2) Redwood to run an initial benchmark against a dedicated test pool using your payloads (target: validate p95 and concurrency).
3) Technical sync (30m) mid-next-week to review results and cost estimates; if green, propose a short reserved capacity trial.

Can you confirm sample payloads and which day next week works for a technical sync?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: redwood-slo-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: 20280327-fintechco-demo-results.csv (CSV)]

Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming and adding a few clarifications:

- p95 latency: target is <= 300ms for 512-token requests; for longer completions (~1k tokens) we are ok with p95 <= 600ms.
- sustained throughput: 150–200 rps during UAT, with up to 350 rps during market open (about 10–15 mins).
- concurrency: 50 steady, 200 burst — yes.
- streaming: important for us — we need partial results to show to traders within 100ms per chunk. We use SSE today; WebSocket would be acceptable if latency is similar.
- authentication: we will use short-lived API keys from our side; we prefer private deployment but open to Dedicated trial.

I'll attach a short sample payload set (2 prompts + expected avg tokens) in a follow-up — prepping with our infra team. Also one question: how do you measure tokenization (your tokenizer vs ours)? Will the benchmark use our token counts?

--
Alex Johnson
Head of Engineering | FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com
[Attachment: (pending) sample-payloads.json]

David / Aditya — forwarding FintechCo confirmation. Key asks we should cover in the benchmark:

- Validate p95 <= 300ms for 512 tokens (LlamaX-13B quantized path)
- Confirm streaming SSE behavior with chunk-size 64 tokens, chunk latency <= 100ms
- Sustain 200 rps for 30 mins and observe tail behavior for 350 rps 10-min burst
- Measure p99 / end-to-end including network overhead (we should run tests from us-west and us-east)

Proposed internal MAP items:
- Aditya: lead perf test setup and share perf-test-instructions.txt + required IAM/key setup by EOD tomorrow.
- David: cost estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial (GPU type + node counts) and ops runbook for streaming config.
- Marissa: coordinate calendar with FintechCo and finalize sample payloads.

I'll suggest Wed/Thu next week for the tech sync; Alex said they'll prep sample payloads.

Thanks — keep it light and focus on measurable wins we can show in the first test run.

--
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Marissa / team — quick technical notes and next actions from my side:

1) Feasibility: targets look reasonable. We can hit p95 <= 300ms for 512-token workloads on a quantized 13B with a dedicated pool, provided we tune batching and KV-cache warmup. Tail latency for bursts is the risk — we'll measure mitigation via autoscale and pre-warm.

2) Streaming: we support SSE and WebSocket streaming. We'll implement SSE for the test with 64-token chunking; I'll instrument chunk emission latency and include metrics in the report.

3) Tokenization: our benchmark will tokenize using Redwood's tokenizer; please provide your sample payloads and we will run both tokenizers to report any delta. If FintechCo has a custom preprocessing step, please include that.

4) Request from FintechCo: please upload sample-payloads.json to the HubSpot file link or share a secure link. We need: 2 short prompts (~128 tokens), 2 medium (~512 tokens), and 1 long (~1k tokens).

5) Timeline: I can spin up the test cluster and begin runs on Thu 2028-03-29 AM PST. Expect initial results within 24 hours of the run.

I'll attach perf-test-instructions.txt (quick checklist + commands) to this thread.

Thanks,
--
Aditya Rao
Sr. Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
